recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, gritty portrait of a man in dark clothing crouching in a graveyard, holding a single black rose horizontally across the frame, set against a stormy sky with silhouettes of crows and heavy, stone-textured typography at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: The horizontal line of the rose stem bisects the dark figure and the foreground typography.
The figure's direct eye contact creates a confrontational yet somber connection with the viewer.
The stone texture of the text mirrors the earthy, grave-like mound in the foreground.
The silhouettes of crows provide a sense of movement against the static, heavy central figure.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Heavy film grain or digital noise texture
Symbolic inclusion of a black rose and crows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale crouching figure occupying the middle and upper thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, chiseled stone lettering at the bottom center serves as the foundational weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the hand holding the rose, following the stem across, then dropping to the heavy title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, moody sky in the upper corners and sides, filled with subtle cloud textures and bird silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing, shadows, sky).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool greys and desaturated greens (stone texture, grass, rose leaves).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted skin tones and the subtle green of the rose stem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast, emphasizing textures over color vibrancy.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide-set serif and slab-serif forms with sharp, aggressive terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear as if carved from weathered granite or concrete
Deep inner beveling to create 3D depth
Heavy distressing and cracks on the surface
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary initials feature interlocking or overlapping strokes with exaggerated sharp points
Secondary text is housed in a stone-textured rectangular banner
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A massive, sharp-serifed display mark paired with a secondary, all-caps slab serif within a stone block.

candidateDirections.reason: For the sharp, aggressive serifs and classic weight.
For the wide, stone-carved feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of a man in a black hoodie and beanie crouching on a dirt mound. He holds a single black rose horizontally. The background is a dark, stormy grey sky with silhouettes of crows. The lighting is moody and directional from the top left. High grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, 3D beveled stone-textured lettering at the bottom center. The top line should be a large stylized monogram with sharp points. Below it, a stone banner containing all-caps slab-serif text with a weathered, chiseled effect.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is made of heavy stone?
Is the rose held horizontally across the middle?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated and dark?
Are there crow silhouettes in the sky?

adjustableVariables: Number of crows in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing brand logos or parental advisory stickers
Exact letter shapes of the monogram

mustAchieve: Heavy visual weight at the bottom

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stone texture on the text matches the foreground dirt.
Check that the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Verify the rose stem is a clear horizontal element.
Confirm the sky has a painterly, stormy texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + symbolic object (rose) + atmospheric elements (crows/storm) + heavy architectural typography = Gritty Gothic Hip-Hop Aesthetic.
